name: Mpox
summary: Clade Ib mpox has community transmission in nine European countries; no mpox emergency of international concern in force
state: WHO's situation report of 14 Sep records community transmission of clade Ib outside Africa in nine European countries, including the UK, France, Germany and Italy, with first detections in Chile and Hungary; Africa reported about 200 cases a week (WHO). Searches to 12 Nov found no newer global count and no new emergency of international concern, so clade I spread outside Africa keeps this at Watch.
for_you: Risk to the general public in the UK remains low. People in sexual networks where clade Ib is circulating are most exposed; UKHSA and NHS guidance sets out symptoms, testing and vaccine eligibility.
rubric_hit: Clade Ib community transmission in 9 countries outside Africa meets the Watch line; no PHEIC, so not Alert

sources.title: WHO — Multi-country outbreak of mpox, external situation report 69

why: Clade I mpox is more severe and has spread beyond Central Africa.
drivers: Case growth, vaccine access, travel-linked spread.

rubric.alert: PHEIC in effect with accelerating growth.
rubric.watch: Clade I spreading outside Africa or a regional surge.
